title: Tree BFS
intuition: Traverse tree nodes level-by-level using a queue, tracking height transitions.
step_by_step_strategy: While queue is not empty, count level size.
Pop level-size elements, process and push children.
common_mistakes: Queue infinite loop by not updating size constraints
Failing to check root node for null beforehand
complexity: Time: O(n), Space: O(w) width of tree
content: Traverse tree nodes level-by-level using a queue, tracking height transitions.
